evidence_quotes.agenda: Never formally asked - customer proactively unloaded an extensive list of concerns unprompted (movers bailed same-day, urgent timeline, wheelchair-accessibility needs).
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep tracked and resolved every concern the customer raised (deep freezer handling, toilet handrail reinstall, bed assembly) with real confirmation by the end of the call - genuine full follow-through, not just acknowledgment.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'That would really depend on how well prepared you are when we get there' - only the window/prep concept was covered; the perks pitch was cut short by the customer before meet-your-mover or on-time guarantee could be delivered.

top_strength: Exceptional patience and empathy with a distressed, rambling customer in a genuine crisis (same-day mover no-show, wheelchair user, urgent move-out deadline) - tracked every detail and confirmed the specific accessibility accommodation (toilet handrail) needed.
coaching_note: The perks pitch (damage coverage, meet-your-mover, on-time guarantee) was interrupted by the customer before finishing, and was never circled back to - meet-your-mover and on-time guarantee never landed anywhere in the call, which cost real points versus a call where the rep re-anchors the pitch after handling an interruption.
